## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 1/11 sectors positive. Market signals mixed and narrow with major risk proxies subdued: SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -0.96% | 1M: -1.65%) and QQQ BELOW TREND (1W: -0.08% | 1M: -1.36%) alongside HYG BELOW TREND (1W: -0.62% | 1M: -0.58%) confirm tepid demand.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**  
Fear showing short-term pickup: VXX RECOVERY (1W: +4.77% | 1M: -5.84%) ↑ rising. Credit and liquidity signals lean mildly tighter with HYG/LQD (HYG BELOW TREND (1W: -0.62% | 1M: -0.58%) / LQD BELOW TREND (1W: -0.94% | 1M: -1.12%)) ↓ falling.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**  
Neutral-to-tightening: TLT BELOW TREND (1W: -1.43% | 1M: -1.34%) ↓ falling suggests modestly higher yields, while LQD BELOW TREND (1W: -0.94% | 1M: -1.12%) ↓ falling points to tighter corporate conditions.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**  
Energy is the lone pocket of strength: Energy breadth + and XLE in CORRECTION (1W: -0.26% | 1M: +6.56%) while most sectors are weak (XLY BELOW TREND (1W: -2.52% | 1M: -6.11%), XLI BELOW TREND (1W: -1.29% | 1M: -8.16%)). Style mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**  
US equities muted: SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -0.96% | 1M: -1.65%) and small caps soft with IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -2.15% | 1M: -4.42%). EM shows pockets of resilience with EEM CORRECTION (1W: -0.22% | 1M: +2.40%) while China FXI BELOW TREND (1W: -3.35% | 1M: -3.67%).

**6. Speculative Appetite?**  
Mixed speculative tone: IBIT CORRECTION (1W: -0.25% | 1M: +21.54%) and ETHA ABOVE TREND (1W: +2.83% | 1M: +30.89%) show one‑month appetite, but IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -2.15% | 1M: -4.42%) and recent VXX pickup temper risk appetite.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**  
Broad commodity strength driven by oil: BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +23.88%) and USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.21% | 1M: +24.11%), while industrial metals are softer with CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -1.24% | 1M: -2.93%). Gold underperformed with GLD BELOW TREND (1W: -1.59% | 1M: -1.15%).

**8. Energy Trend?**  
Oil clearly leading: BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +23.88%) and XLE CORRECTION (1W: -0.26% | 1M: +6.56%) showing month strength but near-term pullback. Natural gas weaker with UNG CORRECTION (1W: -5.21% | 1M: +1.19%).

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**  
CONFIRMED: Oil/energy ETFs (BNO ABOVE TREND (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +23.88%), USO ABOVE TREND (1W: +12.21% | 1M: +24.11%)) show both short- and medium-term strength. DIVERGENCE: Several 1M leaders (IBIT, CORN, WEAT) are in CORRECTION on 1W weakness — notable but not a broad market reversal signal.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**  
Given NEUTRAL regime and narrow breadth, favor commodity/energy exposure (BNO, USO) and reduce exposure to weak cyclicals and small caps (XLY BELOW TREND (1W: -2.52% | 1M: -6.11%), IWM BELOW TREND (1W: -2.15% | 1M: -4.42%)); monitor credit (HYG) and VXX for shifts.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**  
BULLISH: Energy — BNO (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +23.88%) ABOVE TREND and XLE (1W: -0.26% | 1M: +6.56%) CORRECTION for continuation. BEARISH: Consumer Discretionary XLY (1W: -2.52% | 1M: -6.11%) BELOW TREND and Industrials XLI (1W: -1.29% | 1M: -8.16%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**  
BULLISH: Brent/WTI proxies BNO (1W: +13.26% | 1M: +23.88%) and USO (1W: +12.21% | 1M: +24.11%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: Copper CPER BELOW TREND (1W: -1.24% | 1M: -2.93%) and Natural Gas UNG CORRECTION (1W: -5.21% | 1M: +1.19%).

**13. Key Levels?**  
VXX ~20 (short-term complacency threshold), HYG/LQD ratio ~0.80 (credit health inflection), SPY technical pivot near recent support (monitor SPY BELOW TREND (1W: -0.96% | 1M: -1.65%)), XLK/XLF spread as growth-vs-value pivot.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 1/11 sectors positive, market narrow with mixed signals. Energy and oil ETFs (BNO, USO) showing strength while broad equities are BELOW TREND (SPY, QQQ); monitor IBIT/crypto CORRECTION and rising short-term VXX as key divergences.
